from z3 import *
import itertools

weeks = 6
ngroups = 9
size = 3
ngolfers = 27

# assign[w][p] = group of golfer p in week w (integer 0..8)
assign = [[Int(f'a_{w}_{p}') for p in range(ngolfers)] for w in range(weeks)]

solver = Solver()

# Domain constraints
for w in range(weeks):
    for p in range(ngolfers):
        solver.add(assign[w][p] >= 0, assign[w][p] < ngroups)

# Each group has exactly 3 golfers per week
for w in range(weeks):
    for g in range(ngroups):
        solver.add(Sum([If(assign[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(ngolfers)]) == size)

# No pair in same group more than once
for p1, p2 in itertools.combinations(range(ngolfers), 2):
    # Sum over weeks of (assign[w][p1] == assign[w][p2]) <= 1
    solver.add(Sum([If(assign[w][p1] == assign[w][p2], 1, 0) for w in range(weeks)]) <= 1)

print("Model built, solving...")
result = solver.check()
print(f"Result: {result}")
